<!-- pr-reviewer: 4f6526650b5e401debba4df3229f3bf65f020be7 -->
**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This is the read-only safety-floor second pass for #4341 (P1, posted G-code). It builds and tests but changes nothing. On the model: this session runs on Inkling-2-Mini, not Opus. The safety-floor rule names an effort:high (Opus) read-only pass. I cannot confirm that I am that model. The maintainer should confirm the second pass before merge.

**What looks good**
- The lift order is correct. The lift (G91 G28 Z0 or G53 G00 Z..) comes after the G49 cancel of G43.4, then the G90 block ends the G91 of the lift. T M6 and G43 H follow as before.
- The skip logic is correct. No lift for the first section. No second lift after a Go home or a setup-change stop (the zUp flag). No second lift in the upright return after a tilt.
- The #4346 (G17 G94) and #4348 (tcpmLeft) hunks from main are kept in the merged result. The preamble block still states G17 G94, and there is one tcpmLeft declaration, shared with #4341.
- The recorded programs match the post output. The example_catalog suites and the mcp_multiaxis_deburr_post suite pass on the committed text.
- The pinned tests are in the right directory suites (script_wcs/setup_change, script_rotary/upright_after_tilt), no new top-level test binary.

**Where it was built and tested**
- Self-hosted runner (pr-test.yml, run 46115004379): no verdict. The job was cancelled at the max execution time (1h30m) while the quick gate was mid-run (about step 660 of 723). The runner gave no verdict, so the review fell back to local.
- Locally (worktree off pr-4509-review = 4f6526650, trial merge with origin/main: already up to date, no conflicts): the suites that the diff touches, run by name.

**Results (local, head 4f6526650)**
- post:script_wcs: 113 passed, 0 failed (the 5 tool_change_retract pins included)
- post:script_rotary: 67 passed, 0 failed (the upright_after_tilt TCPM pin included)
- app:example_catalog: 50 passed, 0 failed (4 heavy tests ignored)
- app:example_catalog_adaptive: 1 passed
- app:example_catalog_edge_work: 1 passed
- app:first_part_programs: 2 passed
- app:program_entry: 9 passed
- app:mcp_multiaxis_deburr_post: 4 passed (the tilthead golden-match pin included)
- clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean
- light lane (cargo xtask gate light --base origin/main): 4 steps, 0 failed (motion light lib 277s, motion light adaptive2d 45s, app light pocket_pass_start 2s)

**Targeted heavy step (P1, safety floor)**
- The author ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --only "app heavy: example_catalog"` on this head: 1 step, 0 failed, 4 passed (catalog_2d_slots and catalog_2d_adaptive_pocket heavy tests). I accept the author's green result by name (it is in the body of this PR). I did not re-run it.
- Note: the 4 heavy tests in example_catalog are ignored in the default suite; the light lane does not cover them (its twins are motion-side).

**Recorded programs (16 changed .nc files)**
- 29 new `G91 G28 Z0` lines across 15 files (deburr section 2: 1, fanuc_grid_by_part: 6, fanuc_linear_by_tool: 2, fanuc_pause_home: 1, thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form: 1, thread_mill_m8_multi_form: 1, examples/first-part.nc: 2, adaptive-pocket: 1, edge-work: 3, catalog first-part: 2, hole-work: 4, slots: 1, rest: 1, rough-finish: 2, probe-face: 1). Each new line is between the (OPERATION: ...) note and the G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80 block of a later section. No other line changes.
- The deburr file and indexed.nc change the order of G49 / G91 G28 Z0 / G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80 only. G49 comes before the lift (TCPM still armed after the tilted section), the lift follows, then the G90 block. This matches the body. Verified line by line against origin/main.
- The reverted files (.camproj, tormach, tester-kits) are not in this PR. Verified.

**Merged hunks with main (#4346 / #4348)**
- fanuc.cps and doosan-dnm.cps: main's G17 G94 words are kept in the preamble block, and main's one tcpmLeft declaration is kept (shared with the new #4341 code). The #4341 lift (retractBeforeChange) is kept before the block. Verified in the merged code.
- mazak.cps: main did not touch it (#4346/#4348 are fanuc/doosan only); the #4341 lift is kept before the block.
- The two #4341 test files moved into main's directory suites.

**Site tests**
- Not run. Zola and node are not installed on this host, and no site file is touched by this PR. The SKIP on the author's host is not a pass.

**Requested before merge**
- None blocking.
- Note: the runner gave no verdict (cancelled at the job max). The local suites listed above are the evidence.

**Follow-ups (not blocking)**
1. A setup-change stop (M0/M1) after a tilted section writes the retract without a preceding G49. A reference return under G43.4 armed can alarm. Main has the identical code (not a regression of this PR). Worth a follow-up issue (P1 class: setup-change stop after a tilted section does not cancel TCPM before the reference return).
2. Haas, Tormach and LinuxCNC write G49 in the preamble without a lift. Out of scope (#4372).
3. The light lane covers motion-side twins only; the app-side heavy tests in example_catalog remain covered by the author's targeted heavy step.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
